{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lec|toclimit=2|text=The '''LEC 2025 Summer Season''' is the third split of the third year of EMEA's unified professional League of Legends league. In Stage 1, ten teams compete in two groups, where each group plays a best-of-three single round robin, with eight teams advancing to Playoffs, a double elimination bracket.}}
==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Regular Season (Stage 1):
** 10 teams participate
** Two groups of five
** Single Round Robin within each group
** All matches are best of three
** Top four teams of each group advance to [[LEC/2025 Season/Summer Playoffs|Playoffs]]
